name: Ushuaia
tagline: The southernmost city, gateway to Antarctica
summary: Ushuaia is the 'End of the World' city on the Beagle Channel, ringed by snowy peaks. Sail past sea lions to Les Eclaireurs lighthouse, hike Tierra del Fuego National Park, walk with penguins on Isla Martillo and board Antarctic cruises.
seasonNote: Summer (November to March) is mild with long days; winter brings skiing.
arrival: Ushuaia Airport is 10 minutes away; flights from Buenos Aires take 3.5 hours.
cashTip: Argentine prices and exchange rules change quickly; treat peso prices as rough guides. Cards work widely; foreign cards often get a favourable rate.
buyTip: Penguin souvenirs and 'End of the World' stamps.
